targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at), AVG(avg_events_per_second) FROM telemetry_scale_validation_runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at), AVG(replay_backlog) FROM telemetry_scale_validation_runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at), AVG(queue_lag_at_end) FROM queue_recovery_validation_reports GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE workload_stable = true)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 FROM analyst_load_stability_reports WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at), AVG(storage_pressure_pct) FROM infrastructure_pressure_runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at), AVG(replay_amplification_factor) FROM replay_scale_recovery_runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at), AVG(query_latency_ms) FROM infrastructure_pressure_runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT AVG(telemetry_continuity_pct) * 100 FROM telemetry_scale_validation_runs WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at), AVG(cpu_usage_pct), AVG(memory_growth_mb/512) FROM infrastructure_pressure_runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
